status: Read-only source diagnosis and authoring preparation; no semantic mask, cloth material, Blender execution, Unity edits or native acceptance produced.
decision: First audition a precisely reviewed sack-only semantic mask with the existing URP Lit UV0 detail path and detailST near10.7–10.84. Measured density and median anisotropy do not require a new UV channel. Preserve source geometry, UV0, original macro maps and noncloth values. A dedicated cloth coordinate/shader path is a fallback only if the existing atlas seams remain visible in source/native review.
observations: Native iteration03 retains convincing jug/can silhouettes but both sacks read smooth and plasticky. The near source contains 180,000 triangles; this specific material gap is not evidence that another blanket polycount increase would fix cloth.
All triangles belong to one connected source mesh. Two unused vertices form no surface. Whole-mesh Select Linked would select the entire pile.

UV seed region115 covers part of the left sack. Region545 covers much of the central sack and some neighboring corrugated cardboard; automatic whole-region assignment is unsafe. Diagnostic coloured overlays are partial selections, not masks.

Existing color/normal maps are 4096 square and roughness/metallic are original2048 square. Previous exact audit verified R=metallic and A=1-roughness with no wrong pixels, correct linear masks, normal keyword enabled, BumpScale1 and GL no-green-inversion convention.

The seed regions have roughly1,260 area-equivalent texels per metre at the prepared .5483162 uniform fit. A1mm weave covers about.85–1.47 pixels at4K across their5th–95th-percentile density range. These incomplete regions do not establish a complete sack density or directional UV stretch metric.

Follow-up SVD audit: surface-area-weighted p05/median/p95 density is1070/1290/1435px/m on the left seed region and1030/1267/1440px/m on central. Anisotropy is1.04/1.23/1.87 and1.05/1.27/1.86 respectively. Only3.04%/4.25% of these region areas exceed2:1. This supports a bounded existingUV0 detail audition rather than declaring newUVs mandatory.

UV seam orientation remains a visible-review risk: cross-region warp-axis rotation after normal parallel transport has median47.6/48.3degrees, while continuous interior edges have median4.15/3.80degrees. Incomplete seed boundaries include noncloth surfaces, so these counts are not proven cloth-to-cloth seam counts. Fine irregular near-square weave may tolerate some rotation; only a completed semantic mask and rendered audition can settle visibility.

procedure: Import a fresh derivative in the exclusive live Blender session. Verify source SHA, bounds, axis conversion and geometry totals. Blender source review has179,965 triangles versus180,000 in rawFBX/Unity; identify the35 removed degenerate triangles before using index identities.

Locate each sack using the supplied Blender-coordinate seed centroids and compare closest triangles against the stored UV triplets. Store a new imported-mesh face roster with that mesh hash; rawFBX face IDs are diagnostic only.

Select each sack body, folds, mouth and exposed side fabric in face/paint space. Use front/back/top/side views to trace material boundaries; exclude cardboard, both jugs, cans and ground. Do not select by luminance, a bounding rectangle or a complete linked UV region.

Save binary left-sack and central-sack face rosters separately. Review high-contrast coverage renders from all views before texture authoring. Export one combined soft-edge mask only after confirmed boundaries; retain separate IDs for diagnosis.

Rasterize the reviewed semantic mask into original UV0 only after checking for cloth/noncloth UV overlap and mip/gutter bleed. If a cloth UV footprint aliases a noncloth face, stop and use split material/vertex-mask metadata on a derivative instead of modifying shared UV0 texels.
notYetProven: Mask survival across LODs and derived chunks

sourceMaterial.name: Poly Haven Book Pattern
sourceMaterial.pixelInspection: Fine olive woven cotton with small slubs; plausible fibre source. The olive mean color should not replace the current sacks beige identity. Preserve their broad folds, dirt and existing low-frequency color.
recipe: First use existing UV0 with _DetailAlbedoMap_ST near10.7–10.84 and base ST1. AtST10.84, the seed-region median principal tile extents are.266×.321m(left) and.265×.335m(central), compared with the0.3m source tile. Recheck actual Unity instance scale before authoring.

Author neutral fine albedo modulation for the URP detail formula around shader-linear0.5, whose multiplier is2*sample at scale1. Preserve original low-frequency sack color/folds and original base map bytes. If this detail derivative is stored in sRGB, encode linear0.5 correctly; do not assume encoded byte128 is neutral after sRGB decode. Use the reviewed DetailMask alpha to keep excluded surfaces unchanged.

Use the existing URP Lit detail-normal path on UV0; it retains the imported original tangent basis and built-in detail-normal combination. Keep the base normal and BumpScale unchanged. Start with the cloth source normal at its source scale; judge source/native sun/shade and motion before any cloth-only amplitude adjustment. Never multiply normal RGB.

Retain current semantic metallic/roughness unchanged for the first albedo+normal detail audition. Built-in URP Lit detail does not have an independently tiled detail-roughness texture. Only if a visible cloth-specific roughness defect remains, author a masked UV0 roughness derivative or deliberate narrow shader extension. Keep all noncloth values unchanged; do not globally boost roughness or normals.

Retain full source PNGs and original Meshy files. Write new dated derivative maps/mask/mesh/material; never overwrite originals. Displacement source is reference only in this bounded material pass; preserve current geometry.

integration.existingUV0Answer: Existing UV0 can carry a precisely painted semantic DetailMask alpha and independently tiled detail textures once cloth/noncloth overlap and gutter isolation are proven. The same4K atlas cannot bake fine weave sharply at1:1, but detailST near10.7–10.84 avoids that baking-density limit while preserving its valid original tangent mapping.
integration.recommended: First clone the current Surface material into a new dated candidate, retain shader/BaseMap/BumpMap/MetallicGlossMap and base ST1, add reviewed DetailMask alpha plus correctly neutralized cotton detail albedo and source detail normal. Set shared detailST near10.7–10.84, validate URP detail keywords, and preserve all geometry/UVs. Inspect weave rotation at source atlas seams rather than assuming the seams are fatal.
integration.urpContract: Installed LitInput.hlsl209–283 multiplies base albedo by detail factor2*sample (neutral shader-linear0.5), blends DetailNormal using the original tangent basis and samples DetailMask.alpha from unchanged baseUV0. Detail textures use transformedUV0*DetailAlbedoMap_ST. LitDepthNormalsPass141–143 uses the same detail coordinates. The current Surface base ST is1 and detail textures are unbound. No built-in detail-roughness or alternateUV selector exists in this installed shader.
integration.derivedChunkGuard: The first existingUV0/material-only candidate needs normal guarded ShowSources/Rebuild/save behavior. No chunk extension or new vertex attributes are needed. If a later optional extra-UV path is pursued, test attribute and tangent-basis survival through actual Mesh.CombineMeshes before installation.
integration.fallback: Only if completed-mask source/native review shows visible weave seams or unacceptable stretch: preserve UV0, add coherent metric cloth-only coordinates on a derivative and implement their normal basis consistently in forward/depthnormals. A separate dedicated cloth material/atlas is another more invasive fallback. These are alternatives, not prerequisites for the first existingUV0 audition.
preserve: All source geometry positions and triangle connectivity

reviewGates: Accept complete geometry semantic masks from source front/back/top and player-height angles, with zero coverage on jugs/cans/cardboard.
Check originalUV0 overlap and mipped mask edge bleed. Prove outside-mask original maps/values unchanged, including exclusions in semantic-seeds.json.

Check detailST against actual instance scale, shader-linear neutral albedo, source normal orientation and expected weave density. Inspect cross-island phase/rotation and local anisotropy in the completed sack mask. Judge source/native at player distance; the numerical seam count alone is not a rejection.

Install one guarded derivative, rebuild source chunks, save/reopen and inspect matched native cam_ground_trash plus moving near views at noon and completedhour16 reflections. Keep diagnostic passes separate from real-input traversal and performance qualification.
Reject weave sparkle, visible UV orientation breaks, cloth leaking onto jug/can/cardboard, unnaturally sharp overlay folds or washed-out original sack folds.
methodLimits: Flat diagnostic projections sample triangle-centroid albedo. Their faceting is a diagnostic rasterization artifact; they are neither Blender source beauty renders nor native quality evidence. The plan supplies semantic starting points, not an automatically safe authored mask.
